body:
## What it does

A social-listening sweep bounded to a month, so the picture is current rather than whatever ranked highest years ago. Setup installs a skill from a public GitHub repo, which is worth knowing before you run it. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @mvanhorn shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
